title: The Lion and the Mouse

before.title: The Lion and the Mouse
before.text:
A lion was sleeping under a tree. A small mouse ran over his paw. The lion woke up and caught the mouse.

“Please let me go,” said the mouse. “One day I may help you.”

The lion laughed. The mouse was very small. How could it help a lion? Still, the lion let it go.

A few days later, hunters caught the lion in a rope net. The lion pulled hard, but he could not get free.

The mouse heard him and came quickly. It bit the rope again and again. Soon the lion was free.

The lion thanked the mouse. He now knew that a small friend can give great help.

title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf

before.title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
before.text:
A boy watched sheep near his village. The work was quiet, and he became bored.

He shouted, “Wolf! Wolf! Please help!”

People ran from the village. But there was no wolf. The boy laughed.

The next day, he did the same thing. Again, people came. Again, there was no wolf.

Later, a real wolf came near the sheep. The boy was afraid.

“Wolf! Please help!” he shouted.

This time, no one came. They thought the boy was playing another trick.

The sheep ran away. The boy learned something important. People may not believe us after we tell lies.

title: The Fox and the Grapes

before.title: The Fox and the Grapes
before.text:
A hungry fox saw some grapes high above him.

The grapes looked sweet and good. The fox jumped for them, but he could not reach them.

He tried again. He jumped higher this time, but the grapes were still too far away.

The fox tried many times. At last, he became tired.

He looked up at the grapes and said, “I do not want them. They are probably bad.”

Then he walked away.

The fox still wanted the grapes. He only said they were bad because he could not have them. Sometimes people do the same thing when they cannot get what they want.

title: Little Red Riding Hood

The wolf ran ahead to Grandma’s house. Later, the girl arrived and saw the wolf inside.

She knew something was wrong and called for help.

A man working in the forest heard her. He came to the house, and the wolf ran away.

The girl and Grandma were safe. After that, the girl remembered her mother’s words. She stayed on the road.

“You do not look like us,” they said.

When spring returned, the bird saw some beautiful white birds on a lake. He went near them. Then he looked down at the water.

He saw his own face. He was not an ugly duckling at all. He had grown into a beautiful swan.

For the first time, he felt happy to be himself.

title: The Princess and the Pea

before.text:

The queen wanted to know if this was true.

The young woman slept there all night.

In the morning, the queen asked about her sleep.

The young woman said, “No. Something hard was under me. I could not sleep.”

The queen was surprised. The young woman had felt one small pea. It was under many soft beds.

The prince was happy. The young woman stayed at the palace.

title: The Busy Ant Trail

One ant carried a tiny piece of bread. Another carried part of a leaf.

Sara followed the line.

The ants went under a stone and came out again.

They did not walk anywhere they wanted. They followed the same path.

Sara put a small piece of apple near the trail.

Soon one ant found it.

A few minutes later, many ants came.

Sara watched them work together.

The apple was much bigger than one ant, but the group could move it.
